draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

I wanted to check in since your Blue Dynamics workspace went live last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project in place is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
